purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for lifecycle states, retention policies, archive bindings, expiry, holds, purge eligibility and destructive-operation evidence.

owns: DWH Lifecycle and Retention Monitor semantics

topics.name: DWH Lifecycle and Retention Monitor
topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for lifecycle states, retention policies, archive bindings, expiry, holds, purge eligibility and destructive-operation evidence.

semantics.identity_rule: Data identity, lifecycle state, retention policy, hold, archive binding and purge execution identities remain distinct.
semantics.derived_rule: Expiry/purge eligibility is displayed as derived policy state, not as completed deletion.
semantics.action_rule: archive/restore/hold/release-hold/delete/purge operations invoke separate authorized canonical workflows.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing eligible/expired data grants no destructive authority.
semantics.graph_rule: Policy/scope/hold edges correspond only to explicit refs.
semantics.failure_rule: Policy conflicts, blocked purge, failed archive and partial purge states are surfaced explicitly.

invariants.rule: Retention, archival, expiry, purge and hold state are explicit lifecycle semantics over exact data identities; time passage, storage movement or archive location never silently deletes, declassifies, transfers ownership or restores data.

hard_gates.condition: monitor shows expiry as already purged

prose.summary: Define a read-only Expose monitor for lifecycle states, retention policies, archive bindings, expiry, holds, purge eligibility and destructive-operation evidence.
notes: Unlocked pending reconciliation against DWH persistence, deletion, classification and governance contracts.
